title: Finite-to-Qbar push comparison at bounded-below complexes
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite intermediate field E, with finite-subextension-valued condensed algebraic-closure coefficients. Let f:X→Y be proper and let M in the ordinary uncompleted derived internal E-module category of X have a lower cohomological bound N. The component at M of the canonical derivedPushHom coefficient-change transformation from derived E-direct-image followed by extension to Omega to extension followed by derived Omega-direct-image is invertible. No assertion on all unbounded inputs, or on ambient exceptional adjoints, is made.

source.place: Proof plan steps 1–4: scalar-compatible basis decompositions and uniformly bounded-below coproduct continuity for proper pushforward.

proof.text: Grothendieck derived module categories have the required copowers. Choose the compatible scalar-basis decomposition of both extension units. Restriction reflects isomorphisms on derived categories because it is exact and reflects homology isomorphisms. The mate of derivedPushHom is the inverse restriction/pushforward isomorphism.

Scalar compatibility and central naturality give the scalar square required by isIso_iff_unitCoproductComparison. Apply that criterion with the two basis-unit isomorphisms and the invertible mate. It reduces the desired component to the copower comparison for copies of M.
Proper maps are qcqs. All copies of M have the same bound N, so condensedSubfield_bounded_copower_comparison makes the remaining comparison invertible.
